row.title: Lane PR items stayed open a day after their PR closed
row.body: OL-PR-n items were marked vacuous when the PR merged before any queue pass saw the probe fail, so they stayed open for the 24 h vacuous hold. The lane's filing is the recorded failure (contracts.filed_on_failure); queue.run also survives a shallow checkout where balance is unmeasured.
